fields.title: Name
fields.hint: Enter the product name. Example: 'Green Tea Extract'

fields.title: Category
fields.hint: Select a category from the tree structure. Example: 'Beverages > Tea'

fields.title: Brand
fields.hint: Select a brand from the tree structure. Example: 'Samsung > Smart Phones'

rows.description:
#### Name

* Use a **unique, concise** name (e.g., "Wireless Headphones").
* Avoid special characters.

#### Category

* Select the **best-matching category**.
* Contact admin if missing.

#### Brand

* Choose from the list or **add if missing**.
* Ensures proper recognition.

#### Media

* Upload **high-quality** images (JPG, PNG, WebP).
* Recommended: **800x800 px+**, clear background.

fields.title: Use Product Variant
fields.hint: Enable if this product has variants like size or color. Check for multiple variants.

rows.description:
#### MRP (Maximum Retail Price)

* Use a numeric value (e.g., **199.99**).
* **Do not** include currency symbols or special characters.

#### Price (Selling Price)

* Enter a numeric value (e.g., **149.99**).
* **Avoid** currency symbols and unnecessary characters.

fields.title: Stock Control
fields.hint: Enable to manage stock levels for this product. Check to activate stock tracking.

rows.description:
#### Stock Control

* Use the Stock Control toggle to manage **inventory** details for your **product**.
* When Stock Control is **true** then the below **sub-item** will be **visible**.

#### Available

* Enter a numeric value (e.g., **50**).
* **Do not** include text or special characters.

#### ON Hand

* Enter a numeric value (e.g., **50**).
* **Avoid** text or special characters.

#### SKU

* Use a concise code (e.g., **WH-001-TM**).
* **Avoid** spaces and special characters; hyphens or underscores are acceptable if needed.

fields.title: Variant Options
fields.hint: Define options for product variants, such as size and color. Example: Size - Small, Medium, Large.

fields.title: Basic Details
fields.hint: Provide basic details of the product. Use 'Common Basic Details' if the product has variants.

rows.description:
#### Technical Points

* These are key product specifications provided as name and value pairs (e.g., "Battery Life: 8 hours").
* **Name Field**: Enter the technical parameter (e.g., **Weight**, **Screen Size**).
* **Value Field**: Enter the corresponding specification detail (e.g., **1.5 kg**, **15 inches**).

#### Small Description

* Provide a concise summary in one to two short sentences.
* Keep the language engaging and easy to understand.

#### Long Description

* Use a text area that supports multiple paragraphs.
* Organize information into sections if needed (e.g., Features, Benefits, Usage, Care Instructions).

fields.title: Advanced Details
fields.hint: Include additional details such as manufacturer, packer, etc. Example: 'Manufactured by XYZ Corp.'

rows.description:
#### Deliverable Product

* Deliverable Product determines whether your product is eligible for delivery.
* When Deliverable Product is **true** then the below **sub-item** will be **visible**.

#### Manufacturer

* Enter the full official name (e.g., **ABC Electronics**).
* Use text only—avoid extra characters or symbols.

#### Packer

* Provide the official name (e.g., **XYZ Packaging Solutions**).

#### Importer

* Enter the full name of the importer (e.g., **Global Imports Ltd**.).

#### Supplier

* Input the official supplier name (e.g., **Supplier Inc**.).

#### Item Weight

* Enter a numeric value (e.g., **250**).
* Specify or adhere to a consistent unit (**grams**, **kilograms**, etc.) across products.

#### Item Dimensions

* Enter all measurements in centimeters (cm) without appending the unit in the value field.
* **Length:** Numeric value (e.g., **30**).
* **Width:** Numeric value (e.g., **20**).
* **Height:** Numeric value (e.g., **10**).

#### Generic Name

* Enter a concise, descriptive name (e.g., **Wireless Earbuds**).

#### Product Cancel Policy

* Select the appropriate policy from the provided dropdown options.

#### Product Return Policy

* Choose the relevant option from the dropdown menu.
